page.title: Lihokelo
page.intro: Hokela liakhaonto tsa hau tsa papatso. Lieta tse tsoang lipapatsong tsa hau li fihla ho My Leads ka bo eona, ka tšebeliso ea chelete le litjeo tse etellang pele.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form e lebisa ho My Leads, tšebeliso ea letsatsi le letsatsi le litšenyehelo ka moeta-pele ka mong, 'me boleng ba pele bo khutlisetsoa ho LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).
catalog.notAvailable: Ha e so hlophisoe ho seva sena

banner.connected: LinkedIn e hokahane. Lieta li ntse li latoa hona joale - leqephe lena le ka ntlafatsoa ka nakoana.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn ha e so thehoe ho seva sena. Motsamaisi o tlameha ho kenya ID moreki oa app ea LinkedIn le lekunutu.
banner.expired: Khokahano ea LinkedIn e felile, kahoo li-lead ha li lumellane. Hokela hape ho tsoela pele.
banner.reconnectSoon: LinkedIn e hloka hore o kene hape ka {{date}} . Hokela hape pele ho nako ho boloka lisepa li ntse li phalla.

connect.title: Kopanya LinkedIn
connect.intro: Kena ka ak'haonte ea LinkedIn e tsamaisang lipapatso tsa hau. Leadrat e bala liakhaonto tsa hau tsa lipapatso feela, Lead Gen Form e etellang pele le lipalo-palo tsa lipapatso, 'me e romella liphetoho tseo u li bulelang.
connect.need1: Karolo e itseng akhaonteng ea papatso LinkedIn (Sebohi kapa ho feta).
connect.need2: Karolo e leqepheng la k'hamphani e hokahantsoeng (Motsamaisi, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator kapa Analyst) - LinkedIn e hloka hore e arolelane baetapele.
connect.need3: Potso ea nomoro ea mohala ho Lead Gen Forms - e isang ntle le nomoro ea mohala e ke ke ea eketsoa.

connection.title: Khokahano
connection.autoRenews: Phihlelo e nchafatsa ka bo eona ho fihlela ka nako eo
connection.noAutoRenew: Phihlello ha e inchafatse ka bo eona
connection.syncResult: Khokahano e entsoe: {{received}} e amohetsoe, {{created}} e entsoe, {{duplicates}} e kopitsoe, {{rejected}} e lahliloe.
connection.confirmDisconnect: Hlakola LinkedIn ? Ho emisa ho hokahanya le li-tokens tsa phihlello lia hlakoloa. Lieta, lipalo-palo le lenane la liketsahalo li bolokiloe.
connection.noPermission: U ka sheba leqephe lena. Ho hokela le ho fetola litlhophiso ho hloka tumello ea "Laola Litlhophiso".
connection.fetchTitle: Lata lintlha tse ka sehloohong ho latela matsatsi
connection.fetchHint: Litsela tse ncha li hlahlojoa metsotso e meng le e meng e 'maloa' me matsatsi a 7 a ho qetela a hlahlojoa hape letsatsi le leng le le leng, kahoo ha ho letho le fetotsoeng. Sebelisa sena bakeng sa lintlha tsa pele tsa ho hokela, kapa ho sheba nako hape (ho fihla ho matsatsi a 90 ka nako). Likarolo tse seng li ntse li le ho Leadrat li tlositsoe.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Bolella LinkedIn hore na ke efe ea baetapele ba eona e bileng tebello ea 'nete. Ha LinkedIn e etella pele e fihla boemong boo u bo khethileng ka tlase, Leadrat e tlaleha ho LinkedIn , kahoo litlaleho tsa hau tsa phutuho li bontša boleng ba pele 'me LinkedIn e ka fumana batho ba bangata ba kang baeta-pele ba hau ba molemo ka ho fetisisa. Ho romelloa ID feela ea LinkedIn le hash ea tsela e le 'ngoe ea lengolo-tsoibila.
capi.noRules: Ha ho na lipalo tse entsoeng 'mapeng hajoale.
capi.created: Phetoho e entsoe ho LinkedIn mme e entsoe 'mapa.
